component.name: Battery Health Center
component.summary: Battery health, charge limits and app energy usage in one place

description.p: Battery Health Center brings everything about your laptop battery together in one native GNOME app.

ul.li: Charge level, time remaining, power draw and charger wattage
Maximum capacity, condition, cycle count, and capacity over time with a projection
Set a maximum charge level to extend your battery's lifespan, or charge to 100% once
Battery level and power draw history, and battery use during sleep
Apps using the most energy, now and over the last 7 days
Wireless device batteries, notifications, guided calibration and a battery report
Power mode, automatic power mode and GNOME's power-saving settings in one place
Automatic power mode: switches the power mode when you plug in or unplug, or when the charge gets low
GNOME's power-saving settings in one place: dim screen, screen blank, automatic suspend and brightness
Power button and lid actions, and the battery percentage in the top bar
Only the top bar setting works in the snap; the rest needs the regular version

description.p: Fixed: Overview showed a wrong unplug time when the app wasn't running as the charger came out.
When "Record History in the Background" is on, the background copy now steps aside when an update is waiting, so updates install within minutes instead of being held back for up to two weeks.

ul.li: Charge to 100% Now: a one-time full charge, then your limit comes back
Since last charge, charger type and wattage, and battery use during sleep
Power draw chart, and capacity over time with a projected 80% date
Notifications for your charge limit, low battery, app drain and sleep drain
Wireless device batteries, app energy use over 24 hours or 7 days
Guided calibration, battery report export, and two-battery laptops

description.p: Fixes the snap closing straight away on launch without showing a window.
Fixes the snap closing straight away on launch without showing a window.
"Keep After Restart" is now on by default, so a charge limit that is already active gets saved when you click Apply.
